company.what_they_do: web-library.net is a free public email service provider. It offers disposable-style or shared email addresses to users, positioning itself as a privacy-conscious or anonymous email platform. Despite claiming it is 'not a throwaway email service,' its structure (public, free, shared domain) is functionally consistent with temporary/anonymous email services commonly used to bypass registration requirements.
company.raw_notes: Homepage text positions the service as a 'public email service' focused on preventing spam and maintaining a safe environment. Explicitly states it prohibits illegal activities. The domain is used by end-users as an email host (e.g., polyb10261008@web-library.net), not as a business domain. No products, services, team, pricing, or business identity are described on the site beyond the email service itself.
